pullRequest.title: Quote the shipping total as Money, not a formatted string
pullRequest.body:
The shipping quote has been handing back `total` as a display string since the rate card shipped, which means every surface gets the same `$12.99` no matter who is looking at it.

This changes `ShippingQuote.total` to the `Money` value the pricing code already has, so each surface can format it for the customer's own locale and currency later.

Also adds the handler duration to the access log line, which the on-call rotation has been asking for.
pullRequest.author: tomas-lindqvist
